text:
[Council File 26-1537]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (RODRIGUEZ - SOTO-MARTINEZ) relative to authorizing the Community Investment Department’s Office of Youth Development to host their annual Youth Summit at various spaces within City Hall on April 3, 2027.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
AUTHORIZE Community Investment Department’s Office of Youth Development to utilize Council Chambers; City Hall Rotunda; Tom Bradley Tower; and the City Hall Forecourt on April 3, 2027 from 8:30 am to 3:30 pm, with the understanding that the Community Investment Department’s Office of Youth Development will reimburse the City for any costs associated with this event.
